summary: Nora now reads every photo, video, sticker and voice note she receives, so what people send is part of what she remembers instead of an empty marker.
details: Each medium is read once when it arrives, producing a short name for it, a sentence on what it shows, and everything legible in it. The transcript shows the short form beside the marker; her memory keeps all three.
A voice note still shows what was actually said, in full, rather than a summary of it.
media_fetch serves the full reading with no wait, and takes an optional question when what you need is not in the stored reading -- that one costs a fresh look.
Long videos are read in one-and-a-half-minute chunks in order, instead of only the first two minutes. When a clip is longer than she can read, her description says so.
limitations: The read happens in the background, so a photo sent and asked about in the same breath may not be described yet; the marker is there either way and she will say she has not looked rather than guess. A voice note is the exception -- its words are recorded as it arrives.
Videos longer than about fifteen minutes are read only in part, and a part of a clip that will not open is skipped. Both are now stated in the description instead of being silent.

Set [media] comprehension = false to switch the model reads off. Markers only, nothing described -- except that a voice note still keeps its words in the record and in the transcript, because those are captured without a model. With it off her longer-term memory gets the marker alone.
